address: 44 Commercial Street, Spitalfields, London, E1 6LT, United Kingdom
bio: There’s a terrific buzz about this trendy 21st century take on an oyster bar that feels right at home in the streets of Shoreditch. Contemporary artwork – much of it oyster-based – lines the walls of the well-run restaurant, which is split across two levels. The menu makes great reading for seafood-lovers, mixing small plates with a few larger options like cuttlefish lasagne – alongside a selection of both dressed and natural oysters, of course. Be sure not to leave without trying the sticky toffee madeleines....
